Compatible with corroborated FND-0072 (ATT-0027 arc-contraction incompleteness) and FND-0071 (restriction kernel vs. whole group), but distinct: FND-0089 targets ATT-0037's specific chain-homotopy gap in ordered-arc insertion operators on Kunneth-decorated restriction complexes. Mathematical verification: (1) Boundary strata of Mbar_{g,n} are products of lower Mbar spaces connected by clutching maps xi_Gamma: Mbar_Gamma -> Mbar_{g,n}; restriction to one-edge strata involves Kunneth decompositions H^*(Mbar_{v1}) tensor H^*(Mbar_{v2}) at vertices. (2) An ordered-arc insertion operator on a combinatorial arc complex acts on formal generators; to induce a chain homotopy on the geometric restriction complex, one needs explicit transformation rules for how vertex cohomology classes behave under insertion (cohomological rule) and a comparison isomorphism between the arc complex and the Cech/de Rham restriction complex for the clutching stratification. (3) Without (a) and (b), the operator remains a formal combinatorial construction with no established relation to the geometric restriction kernel P^m_{g,n} = ker(H^*(Mbar_{g,n}) -> oplus_{|E(Gamma)|=1} H^*(Mbar_Gamma)), so Tate-type conclusions about P^m_{g,n} cannot be drawn from arc-insertion chain homotopies alone. (4) This is consistent with FND-0031 (at the pure corner, only depth-one Gysin from codim-1 strata contributes; multi-edge/arc-complex bookkeeping is irrelevant unless it controls that specific map) and with the packet's execution boundary requiring complete proof dependencies. Distinct from FND-0072 (broader ATT-0027 incompleteness) and FND-0071 (kernel vs. whole group): do not merge. Promote candidate to corroborated on independent verification of the chain-homotopy gap; evidence_class upgraded from adversarial_review to primary_source.
